mock_data.title: Football Defeat
mock_data.passage:
28/2/02

Dear Jack,

I know you like to hear about home news when you're away at college and so I'm writing to keep you up to speed on the performance of our football team. I know your mother writes frequently, but she's not likely to be interested in the activities of Rowanby United.

For most of the season so far the team's been doing quite well. We've won three games and drawn two. So far, so good, but all this changed on Saturday when we had an away game against Barrowgreen United. I'm not sure that I should tell you the gory details. It's probably best to leave you in blissful ignorance.

We were all pinning our hopes on coming away from the game with at least a draw. The more optimistic among us were confident that we would get a result easily since Barrowgreen have not been playing quite as well as usual. To be honest, this was always a bit of a forlorn hope. The optimists seemed to be forgetting that, whatever their recent performance, Barrowgreen are in second place in the league at the moment. They didn't get there without being able to play reasonably well.

Still, we all got on the bus to go to Barrowgreen, full of enthusiasm and optimism, and looking forward to victory. Of course, this had something to do with the fact that most of us had taken some Dutch courage with our pub lunch.

It would be doing you a kindness to draw a veil over the actual game. It is something that is best not to know about. Our team played appallingly badly as if they had never played together before. In fact you would have thought that some of the players had never even seen a football before. It was unbelievable!

As if this wasn't bad enough, Barrowgreen played absolutely brilliantly. Somehow they had put their recent bad form behind them especially for us. They left us dead in the water and we needn't have bothered playing the second half of the match. The whole match was a humiliation for us and it embarrasses me to write down the score. We lost 5-nil!

Naturally, we were all gutted, as I'm sure you will be when you read this. Sorry to bring you such bad news.

Take care.
Terry

Dear Jack,

Knowing you like to keep up with news from home while you're at college, I thought I'd give you an update on how the football team is doing. Your mother writes often, I know, but I doubt she's particularly interested in the goings-on at Rowanby United.

The team's been performing reasonably well for most of the season. We've managed to win three games and draw two, which is a decent start. However, things took a turn for the worse on Saturday when we had an away game against Barrowgreen United. I'm reluctant to go into all the unpleasant details; perhaps it's better if you remain blissfully unaware of what happened.

We were all hoping we could at least scrape a draw from the game. Some of the more optimistic fans were even confident we'd win fairly easily, as Barrowgreen haven't been playing at their best lately. In hindsight, this was rather wishful thinking. These optimists seemed to be forgetting that, regardless of their recent performances, Barrowgreen are currently second in the league. They didn't reach that position by playing badly.

Nevertheless, we all boarded the bus to Barrowgreen, full of enthusiasm and high spirits, anticipating a victory. Of course, this may have had something to do with the fact that many of us had fortified ourselves with a few drinks during our pub lunch.

It would almost be a kindness to gloss over the actual match. It was truly awful. Our team played terribly, as if they'd never played together before. You'd think some of the players had never even seen a football in their lives! It was truly unbelievable.

To make matters worse, Barrowgreen played exceptionally well. Somehow, they'd put their recent poor form behind them, especially for us, it seemed. They completely outplayed us, and the second half of the match felt almost pointless. The whole game was a complete humiliation, and I'm almost ashamed to write down the score. We lost 5-0!

Naturally, we were all devastated, and I'm sure you will be too when you read this. Sorry to bring you such bad news.

Take care,

Terry
mock_data.passageC1:
Dear Jack,

Knowing your keen interest in all things local, even from the hallowed halls of academia, I thought I'd bring you up to speed on Rowanby United's recent misadventure. While I appreciate that your mother dutifully keeps you abreast of family matters, I daresay the ebb and flow of Rowanby's fortunes are unlikely to feature prominently in her correspondence.

Up until recently, the season had been progressing reasonably well. Three victories and a couple of draws suggested a team finding its footing. However, this modicum of success came crashing down around our ears this past Saturday, courtesy of an away fixture against Barrowgreen United. Perhaps I should spare you the unvarnished truth, allowing you to remain blissfully unaware of the debacle that unfolded.

Most of us were harbouring hopes of at least securing a draw. A few, fuelled by a perhaps unduly optimistic assessment of Barrowgreen's current form, even dared to predict a win. It has to be said, such optimism bordered on the naive. These fervent supporters conveniently overlooked the fact that, despite their recent lapses in form, Barrowgreen currently occupies second place in the league – a position they clearly hadn't stumbled upon.

Nevertheless, we boarded the bus to Barrowgreen, buoyed by enthusiasm and the anticipation of victory. This sense of invincibility, it must be admitted, was likely compounded by a generous dose of Dutch courage consumed during our pre-match pub lunch.

It would almost be an act of kindness to draw a veil over the match itself. Suffice to say, it was a performance best left forgotten. Our team performed with an almost unprecedented lack of cohesion, as if they were complete strangers to one another, let alone seasoned teammates. One might have surmised that certain players were encountering a football for the very first time. It was truly an astounding display of ineptitude!

To add insult to injury, Barrowgreen, as if galvanized by some unseen force, played with exceptional skill, seemingly having reserved their best performance specifically for us. They utterly annihilated us, rendering the second half an exercise in futility. The entire match was a profound humiliation, and I almost cringe at the thought of writing down the final score. We suffered a crushing defeat of 5-nil!

Naturally, everyone is utterly crestfallen, a sentiment I'm sure you'll share upon reading this. Apologies for being the bearer of such unwelcome news.

Take care.Terry

28/2/02

Hurmatli Jek,

Bilaman, sen kollejda bo'lganingda uy yangiliklarini eshitishni yoqtirasang va shuning uchun men senga bizning futbol jamoamizning ko'rsatkichlari haqida xabardor qilish uchun yozyapman. Bilaman, onang tez-tez yozadi, lekin u Roanbi Yunayted faoliyatiga qiziqishi dargumon.

Mavsumning ko'p qismida jamoa juda yaxshi o'ynadi. Biz uchta o'yinda g'alaba qozondik va ikkitasida durrang natija oldik. Hozirgacha hammasi yaxshi edi, ammo shanba kuni Barroygrin Yunayted bilan mehmon o'yinimiz bo'lganida hammasi o'zgarib ketdi. Senga jirkanch tafsilotlarni aytishim kerakmi bilmayman. Seni baxtli nodonlikda qoldirishim yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin.

Biz hammamiz o'yindan hech bo'lmaganda durrang natija bilan qaytishga umid qilgan edik. Oramizdagilarning ko'proq optimistlari biz osonlikcha natija olishimizga ishonch bildirdilar, chunki Barroygrin odatdagidek yaxshi o'ynamayapti. Rostini aytsam, bu har doim arzimagan umid edi. Optimistlar Barroygrining yaqingi natijalaridan qat'i nazar, hozirda ligada ikkinchi o'rinda turishini unutayotganga o'xshaydi. Ular u yerga yetarlicha yaxshi o'ynamasdan yeta olmadilar.

Baribir, biz hammamiz g'alaba umidida, ishtiyoq va optimizm bilan Barroygringa boradigan avtobusga chiqdik. Albatta, bu bizning ko'pchiligimiz pub tushligimiz bilan birga hollandiyalik jasorat olganligimiz bilan bog'liq edi.

Haqiqiy o'yin ustiga parda tashlash senga mehrbon bo'lardi. Bu bilmaslik yaxshi narsa. Bizning jamoa go'yo ular hech qachon birga o'ynamagandek dahshatli yomon o'ynadi. Aslida ba'zi o'yinchilar hech qachon futbol to'pini ham ko'rmaganga o'xshardi. Bu ishonib bo'lmas edi!

Bu yetarli darajada yomon bo'lmagandek, Barroygrin mutlaqo ajoyib o'ynadi. Qandaydir yo'l bilan ular yaqingi yomon formasini biz uchun maxsus ortda qoldirgan edilar. Ular bizni suvda o'lik qoldirdilar va o'yinning ikkinchi yarmini o'ynashga ara qilmasligimiz mumkin edi. Butun o'yin biz uchun sharmanda bo'lish edi va hisobni yozish meni sharmanda qiladi. Biz 5-0 hisobida yutqazdik!

Tabiiy, biz hammamiz juda xafa edik, ishonchim komilki, buni o'qiganingda sen ham xafa bo'lasan. Bunday yomon yangiliklarni keltirganimdan uzr.

O'zingga ehtiyot bo'l.
Terri

Aziz Jek,

Sening kollejda yurganingda uy yangiliklaridan xabardor bo'lishni yaxshi ko'rishingni bilganim uchun, futbol jamoasi qanday o'ynayotgani haqida senga ma'lumot bermoqchiman. Onang tez-tez yozadi, bilaman, lekin u Rowanby Unitedda bo'layotgan voqealarga qiziqishi dargumon.

Jamoa mavsumning ko'p qismida yetarlicha yaxshi o'ynadi. Uchta o'yinda g'alaba qozondik va ikkita o'yinda durang o'ynadik, bu yaxshi boshlanish. Biroq, shanba kuni Barrowgreen Unitedga qarshi safarda o'yinimiz bo'lganida, vaziyat yomon tomonga o'zgardi. Men barcha yoqimsiz tafsilotlarga kirishga ishtiyoqim yo'q; balki nima bo'lganini bilmaganing yaxshiroqdir.

Biz hech bo'lmaganda o'yinda zo'rg'a durang o'ynashga umid qilgandik. Hatto ba'zi bir optimistik muxlislar ham biz nisbatan osonlik bilan g'alaba qozonishimizga ishonch bildirishdi, chunki Barrowgreen oxirgi paytlarda eng yaxshi o'yinini ko'rsatmayapti. Keyinroq o'ylab qarasak, bu xom xayol edi. Bu optimistlar, yaqindagi o'yinlariga qaramay, Barrowgreen hozirda ligada ikkinchi o'rinda ekanligini unutgandek edi. Ular bu pozitsiyaga yomon o'ynab erishmadilar.

Shunga qaramay, biz hammamiz g'alaba umidida, ko'tarinki ruhda Barrowgreenga avtobusga o'tirdik. Albatta, buning sababi ko'pchiligimiz tushki ovqat paytida bir necha ichimlik bilan o'zimizni mustahkamlaganimiz bo'lishi mumkin.

Haqiqiy o'yin haqida jim o'tib ketish deyarli yaxshilik bo'lardi. Bu juda dahshatli edi. Bizning jamoamiz juda yomon o'ynadi, go'yo ular hech qachon birga o'ynamagandek. Ba'zi futbolchilar umuman futbol ko'rmagan deb o'ylaysiz! Bu haqiqatan ham ishonish qiyin edi.

Vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirish uchun Barrowgreen juda yaxshi o'ynadi. Qandaydir tarzda ular yaqindagi yomon holatlarini ortda qoldirishdi, ayniqsa biz uchun shekilli. Ular bizni butunlay ustunlik qildilar va o'yinning ikkinchi yarmi deyarli ma'nosizdek tuyuldi. Butun o'yin butunlay sharmandalik edi va men hisobni yozishga deyarli uyalaman. Biz 5-0 hisobida mag'lub bo'ldik!

Tabiiyki, biz hammamiz tushkunlikka tushdik va bu xabarni o'qiganingda sen ham tushkunlikka tushishingga aminman. Bunday yomon xabar keltirganim uchun uzr.

O'zingni ehtiyot qil,

Terri
mock_data.translationC1:
Qadrli Jek,

Sizning har qanday mahalliy narsaga, hatto akademiya devorlaridan ham qiziqishingizni bilgan holda, men sizni Rowanby Unitedning yaqindagi muvaffaqiyatsizligi haqida xabardor qilmoqchi edim. Onangiz sizni oilaviy masalalar bilan doim xabardor qilib turishini qadrlayman, lekin Rowanbyning omadlari uning xatlarida unchalik aks etmasligiga aminman.

Yaqingacha mavsum ancha yaxshi o'tayotgandi. Uchta g'alaba va bir nechta durang jamoaning o'z o'rnini topayotganini ko'rsatardi. Biroq, bu kichik muvaffaqiyat o'tgan shanba kuni Barrowgreen Unitedga qarshi safar o'yinida barbod bo'ldi. Ehtimol, men sizni haqiqatni bezi bilan o'ramasdan, sodir bo'lgan falokatdan bexabar qoldirishim kerakdir.

Aksariyatimiz hech bo'lmaganda durang o'ynashga umid qilgandik. Ba'zilar, Barrowgreenning joriy holatini ortiqcha optimistik baholashga asoslanib, hatto g'alaba bashorat qilishga ham jur'at etishdi. Shuni aytish kerakki, bunday optimizm soddalikka yaqin edi. Bu ishtiyoqli muxlislar, ularning so'nggi omadsizliklariga qaramay, Barrowgreen hozirda ligada ikkinchi o'rinni egallab turganini unutishdi – bu o'rinni ular aniq tasodifan egallamagan.

Shunga qaramay, biz g'alaba ishtiyoqi va umidi bilan Barrowgreenga avtobusga o'tirdik. Tan olish kerakki, bu g'alabaga bo'lgan ishonch, o'yingacha bo'lgan tushlikda iste'mol qilingan "dutch courage"ning saxovatli dozasi bilan kuchaygan bo'lishi mumkin.

O'yinning o'ziga pardani tortish deyarli yaxshilik bo'lardi. Shuni aytish kifoya, bu unutilgan holda qoldirilishi kerak bo'lgan spektakl edi. Bizning jamoamiz deyarli misli ko'rilmagan darajada aloqasiz o'ynadi, go'yo ular bir-biriga butunlay begona odamlar edi, hatto tajribali jamoadoshlar ham emas. Ba'zi o'yinchilar futbolni birinchi marta ko'rishayotgandek taassurot qoldirdi. Bu haqiqatan ham hayratlanarli darajadagi qobiliyatsizlik namoyishi edi!

Holatni yanada og'irlashtirish uchun, Barrowgreen, go'yo ko'rinmas kuchdan ilhomlangandek, ajoyib mahorat bilan o'ynadi, go'yo ular o'zlarining eng yaxshi o'yinini aynan biz uchun saqlab qo'yishgandek. Ular bizni butunlay yo'q qilib tashlashdi, bu esa ikkinchi bo'limni befoyda mashqga aylantirdi. Butun o'yin chuqur kamsitish edi va men yakuniy hisobni yozish haqida o'ylashga ham jur'at qilolmayman. Biz 5-0 hisobida mag'lubiyatga uchradik!

Tabiiyki, hamma mutlaqo tushkunlikka tushgan, bu his-tuyg'uni siz ham buni o'qiganingizdan so'ng his qilishingizga aminman. Bunday yoqimsiz xabar yetkazganim uchun uzr so'rayman.

O'zingizni ehtiyot qiling.Terry
